# War Scroll Column 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**18:1** [...Blessed-be] the God-of-Israel, who keeps covenant-faithfulness with His covenant [...] and the appointed-times-of

**18:2** salvation with the people-of His-redemption. He has called the ones-stumbling to wonderful-mighty-deeds, and He has gathered the assembly-of

**18:3** the nations for destruction-without-remnant [...] the gates-of-salvation He has opened many-times [...] the covenant-of-peace [...]

**18:4** [...] and the star of [...] and [...] Jacob [...] Your splendor shall [...]

**18:5** [...] Your mighty-ones [...] in the gates [...] many-times [...]

**18:6** [...] and Belial [...] and all the spirits-of-his-lot [...] they shall fall in [...]

**18:7** [...] great destruction [...] for they shall not stand [...] in the war [...]

**18:8** [...] from-of-old You have appointed the appointed-time of [...] the mysteries-of [...]

**18:9** [...] to make-known [...] our enemies have fallen [...] the might [...]

**18:10** [...] the mighty-warriors of [...] Your great hand [...] the enemies-of-Your-people [...]

**18:11** [...] and the hand-of [...] the slain [...] and the warriors [...]

**18:12** [...] and upon the earth [...] the peoples [...] and the mighty-ones [...]

**18:13** [...] to give-thanks [...] the great-deeds-of-God [...] His covenant-faithfulness [...]

**18:14** [...] for our God [...] the congregation of [...] forever [...]

**18:15** [...] and truth [...] eternity [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 18 is heavily damaged — a victory hymn celebrating God's triumph. Only fragments survive for most lines. Construct chains hyphenated. "Covenant-faithfulness" (chesed) per project convention. Lacunae marked with [...] following Yadin's reconstruction markers.*
